business_objective: Verify completion evidence for project actions and close each action record after completion is confirmed.

stakeholder_statements.text: The project coordinator creates an action record and identifies the action owner and expected outcome.
The action owner records a completion note and attaches completion evidence.
The outcome verifier records the evidence as accepted or returned and adds a reason when it is returned.
The project coordinator marks the action completed only after the evidence is accepted.
The project sponsor closes the action record after completion is recorded. Milestone rescheduling and budget changes are outside this project.

business_objective: Record kitchen-station handover information and close each handover after receipt and readiness are confirmed.

stakeholder_statements.text: The outgoing station lead creates a handover record and identifies the kitchen station and service period.
The outgoing station lead records any remaining preparation task and any equipment issue.
The incoming station lead acknowledges receipt of the handover.

The shift supervisor closes the handover only after receipt acknowledgement and a readiness outcome are recorded. Staff scheduling and equipment repair are outside this project.

business_objective: Review proposed speaker substitutions and update an event agenda after content clearance and event-direction acceptance.

stakeholder_statements.text: A session host submits a speaker-substitution request and identifies the session, unavailable speaker, and proposed replacement.
The program coordinator records the substitution reason and supporting evidence. The accepted evidence types have not been agreed.
The content curator records whether the proposed replacement may deliver the existing session material. The clearance criteria are undecided.
The event director records the substitution as accepted or declined and adds a reason when it is declined.

The agenda clerk updates the session speaker only after content clearance and event-director acceptance are recorded, then sends the outcome to the session host. The delivery channel is undecided. Speaker travel booking and speaker payment are outside this project.

business_objective: Review potentially duplicate support cases and merge confirmed duplicates after content-transfer and approval decisions are recorded.

stakeholder_statements.text: A support agent flags a potential duplicate and identifies the proposed primary case and secondary case.
The case analyst records the supporting duplicate indicators and records the cases as duplicate or distinct. The duplicate-assessment criteria have not been agreed.
The case data steward records which notes and attachments are eligible to move into the primary case. The excluded-content categories are not finalized.
The support lead records the proposed merge as approved or rejected and adds a reason when it is rejected.

The case operations clerk merges the secondary case into the primary case only after duplicate status and merge approval are recorded, then sends the outcome to the assigned support agents. The delivery channel is undecided. Customer-account deletion and refund processing are outside this project.

business_objective: Review requests to disclose a peer reviewer's identity while preserving an unresolved consent requirement.

stakeholder_statements.text: A research author submits a reviewer-identity release request and identifies the manuscript and completed review.
The review coordinator records whether the review is closed. The coordinator says the reviewer's identity may be shown to the research author once the review is closed.
The ethics reviewer records a disclosure assessment and any restrictions. The reviewer says the identity must remain hidden unless the peer reviewer explicitly consents.
The reviewer liaison records whether the peer reviewer consented and records the consent evidence. The accepted consent-evidence types have not been agreed.

The research governance officer records an approved or declined release decision after review closure, the disclosure assessment, and consent status are present, then sends the outcome to the research author. Nobody has decided who resolves the disclosure conflict, which identity fields may be released, which delivery channel to use, or the maximum decision time. Manuscript editing and reviewer payment are outside this project; the meeting also drifted into complaints about the coffee machine.
